intent.actor: a person who presses Save twice while the first save request is still pending
intent.observableSuccess: exactly one save request is sent and the button reads as pending until it settles
intent.nonGoals: retry after failure, offline queueing, server-side idempotency
intent.worstRegression: the second press sends a second save request
intent.reversibility: revert the form change; no data is migrated

sources.standard: the user's answers in Space discovery

requirements.quote: While a save request is pending, a second submit sends no request.

terms.name: presses while pending
terms.path: test: the adapter submits twice before the first request settles
terms.definition: how many times Save is pressed before the first response

terms.name: requests sent
terms.path: fetch mock call count read by the adapter
terms.definition: how many save requests reached the network layer

hazards.permission-change: n/a: S1 the policy has no permission
hazards.display-vs-commit: n/a: S1 the policy states no display rule
hazards.identity-reference: n/a: S1 no identity is involved

families.Data: excluded: S4 one form, no list or volume
families.Value: excluded: S4 the form's field values do not change the request count
families.Async: excluded: S4 the save response is not awaited by this policy; only the presses before it count
families.Entry: excluded: S4 one form opened fresh
families.Environment: excluded: S4 no viewport or theme rule
families.Platform: excluded: S1 any browser the repo supports behaves alike
